responsibilities: Initiates fluent execution chains via static method AtomicPipeline.begin(db, context)
Enforces duck-typed PipelineContext interface validation (must implement trackMutation)
Instantiates an isolated TransactionTracker instance and state payload object
Executes step boundaries eagerly wrapped inside SyncPromise chain
Intercepts boundary exceptions and automatically executes LIFO rollback prior to consumer error propagation
nodes.time_complexity: O(1) pipeline initiation, O(S) step execution where S is step count

responsibilities: Wraps raw DynamicRepository instances dynamically during addStep calls
Intercepts insert/insertMany mutations and registers trackInsert/trackInsertMany undo actions in TransactionTracker
Intercepts update/updateMany mutations, snapshots original row data via toDatabaseRow(), and registers trackUpdate undo actions
Intercepts remove/deleteMany mutations, snapshots backup models, and registers trackDelete undo actions
Delegates read operations (findById, where, all) directly to the underlying raw repository
nodes.time_complexity: O(1) interception per single row mutation, O(K) snapshot captures for batch mutations

responsibilities: Maintains an ordered stack of mutation undo operations (steps array)
Supports trackInsert, trackInsertMany, trackUpdate, trackDelete, and trackSync operation entries
Executes rollback operations in strict Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) reverse chronological order
Restores deleted records directly via TableGateway.insert(toDatabaseRow()) to preserve original primary key IDs
Restores updated rows directly to original row backup states
nodes.time_complexity: O(M) LIFO rollback execution where M is total tracked mutations

nodes.layer: Domain Context & Mutation Manifest Synchronization Layer
responsibilities: Maintains mutationManifest array tracking mutated repository names
Safely forwards client metadata (auth context, user roles, env, headers)
Provides trackMutation(repositoryName) method for dynamic manifest registration during step completion

relationships.description: Validates PipelineContext contract at initialization and updates mutationManifest via context.trackMutation(repoName)
Creates dedicated TransactionTracker instance and calls tx.rollback() upon step boundary fracture
Wraps raw DynamicRepository in TrackingRepository facade and passes it to step operation blocks
Calls trackInsert, trackUpdate, trackDelete on TransactionTracker during repository mutations
Re-inserts deleted backup rows directly via TableGateway.insert() to preserve original primary key IDs
